capabilities: Embed an HTML file or a named interactive panel in a note
Save the scene ID and parameters inside the embed link
Find notes that link to or embed a scene
Guide a coding assistant to author scene-aware HTML pages
extras: Installed manually from GitHub release files; embedded pages run their own scripts in a sandboxed iframe without access to the plugin API, so only trusted files should be opened; relative resource links in sibling files do not resolve against the vault; mobile support is unverified; no remote service, account or telemetry.
problem: A plain HTML embed in Obsidian cannot reopen a specific interactive state, so a reader has to repeat the same selections by hand.

relations.evidence: The obsidian-html-scenes skill guides a coding assistant that creates or adapts that HTML.

summary: Embeds an HTML page or one of its named interactive panels in a note and saves the panel's state so the embed reopens the same selection.
